item.description: Good morning, Naresh, and happy Sunday, May 24th, 2026, here in Sydney! It's a partly cloudy 17°C out there right now, feeling just as mild, and we're looking at a comfortable range of 14°C to 20°C today. As you head out, remember that 86% chance of rain – best to grab that umbrella! Make today count, embrace the fresh start, and enjoy every moment of your Daily Drive.
